note: Lincoln County MO zoning districts (Zoning Troy, Moscow Mills Zoning, Winfield Zoning) are layers in the county's Lincoln_Assessor_Data MapServer on services8.integritygis.com, which returns 'Token Required' for the service and every layer; the Geocortex directory marks their query flags off. The county has no zoning department; Troy, Elsberry, Moscow Mills and Winfield run their own zoning. No public, token-free zoning district service was found for the county or its cities, so I did not work around the token.
